primary.title: Property sale in India: NRI sellers face different TDS rules from residents—here's what to know
primary.summary: Selling property in India can trigger very different TDS rules for NRI and resident sellers. While buyers generally deduct 1% TDS on qualifying purchases from residents, NRI property sales are taxed differently, with the deduction linked to applicable capital gains tax rates.
